cent=[(3,5,2),(4,20,6),(21,22,8)]
ok_all=True
for r in range(30):
    for c in range(30):
        exp=o[r][c]
        reach=[]
        for (r0,c0,colg) in cent:

            if all(v in (0,colg) for v in cells): reach.append((abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0),colg))
        reach.sort()
        pick=reach[-1][1] if reach else None
        if pick!=exp: print(r,c,i[r][c],'->',exp,'got',pick); ok_all=False
print(ok_all)

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cen=[(r,c,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]!=3 and r>0 and r<H-1 and c>0 and c<W-1 and inp[r-1][c]==3 and inp[r+1][c]==3 and inp[r][c-1]==3 and inp[r][c+1]==3]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    res={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c]!=0: continue
            cand=[]
            for r0,c0,col in cen:
                if (r0==r and 0<=c<W) or (c0==c and 0<=r<H):
                    # Manhattan distance along straight path
                    d=(abs(r-r0)+abs(c-c0))
                    cand.append((d,col,r0,c0))
            if not cand: continue
            cand.sort()
            res[(r,c)]=cand[0][1]
    return res

import numpy as np, json
T=np.array(G['Test input']); H,W=T.shape
# plus detection: value v non-bg, orth neighbors equal v, diag differ (or bg)
def find_pluses(d):
    res=[]
    cnt=np.bincount(d.ravel()); bg=cnt.argmax()
    for r in range(1,H-1):
        for c in range(1,W-1):
            v=int(d[r,c])
            if v==bg: continue
            orth=[int(d[rr,cc]) for rr,cc in [(r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)]]
            diag=[int(d[rr,cc]) for rr,cc in [(r+1,c+1),(r+1,c-1),(r-1,c+1),(r-1,c-1)]]
            if all(o==v for o in orth) and all(x!=v for x in diag):
                # arms length limit check
                res.append((r,c,v))
    return res
print(find_pluses(T))
